coverage.rule: A value from a row whose coverage is under 50% is withheld: null, with a reason next to it.

prediction_accuracy.label: Accuracy of MBTA's published predictions by horizon bucket

provenance.definition: Accuracy of MBTA's published predictions by horizon bucket
sql: select line, horizon_bucket, window_label as window, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then median_abs_error_s end, 2) as median_abs_error_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then p90_abs_error_s end, 2) as p90_abs_error_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then mae_s end, 2) as mae_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then pct_within_60s end, 2) as pct_within_60s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then pct_within_120s end, 2) as pct_within_120s, n as n_observations, round(coverage_pct, 1) as coverage_pct, not (coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50) as withheld from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_accuracy_window.parquet') where window_label = 'last_7d' and line = 'Blue' order by line, try_cast(split_part(horizon_bucket, '-', 1) as integer), horizon_bucket limit 501
